name: USA Spending API
tagline: Federal award spending data from USAspending.gov for contracts, grants, loans, and more.
description: Public REST API from the U.S. Treasury’s USAspending.gov that exposes federal award and spending data: contracts, grants, loans, direct payments, and agency budgets. Developers query awards, recipients, agencies, and geographic breakdowns as JSON without an API key for most endpoints.

auth.details: No authentication required for public endpoints; requests are open over HTTPS.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public API; no paid plans or usage quotas published

use_cases: search federal contract awards by agency or keyword
look up grant spending for a recipient or location
list top-tier federal agencies and budget authority
get award details for a known award ID
break down federal spending by state or congressional district
